import FreeCAD
import Part

# Create a new document
doc = FreeCAD.newDocument("Cube")

# Create a box with dimensions 24mm x 18mm x 12mm
# Box is created at origin with specified dimensions
box = Part.makeBox(24, 18, 12)

# Create a part feature and set the shape
part = doc.addObject("Part::Feature", "Cube")
part.Shape = box

# Recompute the document to ensure everything is valid
doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

print("Cube created successfully:")
print(f"  Length: {box.BoundBox.XLength} mm")
print(f"  Width: {box.BoundBox.YLength} mm")
print(f"  Height: {box.BoundBox.ZLength} mm")
EOF

import FreeCAD

# Open the saved document
doc = FreeCAD.open("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")

# Check if the document has objects
print(f"Document name: {doc.Name}")
print(f"Number of objects: {len(doc.Objects)}")

for obj in doc.Objects:
    print(f"\nObject: {obj.Name}")
    print(f"  Type: {obj.TypeId}")
    
    # Check if it's a Part::Feature and get its shape info
    if hasattr(obj, 'Shape'):
        shape = obj.Shape
        print(f"  Shape type: {shape.ShapeType}")
        bbox = shape.BoundBox
        print(f"  Bounding box:")
        print(f"    X (Length): {bbox.XLength} mm")
        print(f"    Y (Width): {bbox.YLength} mm")
        print(f"    Z (Height): {bbox.ZLength} mm")

# Verify dimensions match requirements
cube_obj = doc.getObject("Cube")
if cube_obj:
    shape = cube_obj.Shape
    bbox = shape.BoundBox
    
    length_ok = abs(bbox.XLength - 24.0) < 0.001
    width_ok = abs(bbox.YLength - 18.0) < 0.001
    height_ok = abs(bbox.ZLength - 12.0) < 0.001
    
    print(f"\nDimension verification:")
    print(f"  Length 24mm: {'PASS' if length_ok else 'FAIL'} ({bbox.XLength})")
    print(f"  Width 18mm: {'PASS' if width_ok else 'FAIL'} ({bbox.YLength})")
    print(f"  Height 12mm: {'PASS' if height_ok else 'FAIL'} ({bbox.ZLength})")
    
    if length_ok and width_ok and height_ok:
        print("\nAll dimensions verified successfully!")
    else:
        print("\nDimension mismatch detected!")

doc.close()
EOF
